### Assessment of Acme's Diversification into Robotics

**Overview of the Argument:**
Acme is diversifying into robotics for the first time, introducing an inspection robot designed for warehouse inventory counting, which is scheduled for release in Q4 2026 [1]. This robot is built to integrate directly with the systems at the Memphis distribution center [1].
